A short bright curved reflection lies at the lower right edge. No colour flow overlay is present; no scale bar or numeric measurement readout is legible.

visual.general_description: Two axial pelvic CT slices side by side, non-contrast on the left and contrast-enhanced on the right, each showing a large rounded mass; the right image shows a brighter peripheral rim, a darker centre and a yellow arrow.
visual.detailed_description: Panel a is an axial non-contrast slice with a large intermediate-density heterogeneous rounded mass in the central pelvis and a darker crescent in front of it. Panel b is a similar level after contrast with a thick brighter irregular rim of the mass, darker uneven centre, small bright dots along the upper margin and a yellow arrow at the upper left edge. Both have a white lowercase panel letter.

panels.general_description: Axial non-contrast CT slice of the pelvis showing a large rounded heterogeneous soft-tissue mass with a darker crescent in front of it.
panels.detailed_description: Axial grayscale CT slice with a white lowercase letter a at the upper left. The body outline is wide and oval with a thin dark rim of subcutaneous fat, symmetric soft tissue on both sides, bright bony structures on the left and right (iliac wings) and a bright bony structure at the lower middle posterior margin (sacrum and coccyx). A large rounded region of intermediate soft-tissue density, slightly heterogeneous, occupies the central pelvis. Directly in front of and above it lies a crescent-shaped region of darker, more uniform density. Thin bright curved lines below the body are the table. No arrow or annotation is present; no contrast-enhanced areas can be compared in this panel.
